description: Staged execution order for the tree-model time-series benchmark. Tiers are ordered by expected compute cost and MetaGB smoke-test signal.

tiers.name: tier1_fast_core
tiers.description: Low-channel datasets that finish comparatively quickly. Run these first to establish the main MetaGB-vs-tree baseline table early.

tiers.name: tier2_slow_favorable
tiers.description: Compute-heavy PEMS datasets where smoke tests showed clear MetaGB advantage. Run after tier1 to strengthen the high-dimensional multivariate story.

tiers.name: tier3_slow_unfavorable
tiers.description: Compute-heavy datasets where smoke tests did not show a clear MetaGB advantage. Keep as robustness/appendix material or run last.
